description: This file implements a utility class and a helper function for extending the subgraph pattern matching capabilities in torch.fx, specifically adding support for matching nodes by name within pattern graphs. It defines a subclass of SubgraphMatcher that incorporates a name-to-node mapping, enabling more descriptive and fine-grained pattern matching in computational graphs.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcherWithNameNodeMap
classes.description: An extension of SubgraphMatcher that supports querying matched subgraph nodes via a name-to-node mapping, facilitating pattern matching based on node names within the subgraph.

methods.description: A helper function that processes a GraphModule to extract a mapping from node names to nodes, and adjusts the graph accordingly for matching.

methods.name: list[InternalMatch] match(self, graph: Graph, node_name_match: str = "")
methods.description: Overrides the base match method to include node name to node object mapping in each InternalMatch result, enabling users to access nodes by name after a pattern match.
